## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] No data-deleting code path (never delete rows or clear cells)
- [ ] UI consistency (standard tokens, plain words, no emojis)
- [ ] Docs updated (CHANGELOG.md, README.md if user-facing)
- [ ] No personal data included in code, fixtures, or commits
- [ ] Tried it in Chrome (load unpacked) if it touches the popup, settings, dashboard or page button
